commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Gustaf Lagerbielke (Sweden) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
90+6' Sweden have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gustaf Lagerbielke (Sweden), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+4' Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+3' It's time for a substitution. Elliot Stroud (Sweden) comes on in place of Gabriel Gudmundsson.

89' 5 - 1 Goal - 5:1! Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Memphis Depay provided an assist for the goal.

85' Besfort Zeneli (Sweden) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Bart Verbruggen and his nice save.
85' The corner from Anthony Elanga (Sweden) is intercepted by the defence.

84' Alexander Isak (Sweden) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Bart Verbruggen makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play. Sweden will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Micky van de Ven (Netherlands) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
82' The linesman signals that Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
80' Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
79' Substitution. Taha Ali (Sweden) in, Yasin Ayari out.

69' A cooling break is underway.

64' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

63' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Netherlands will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Yasin Ayari (Sweden) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
61' Anthony Elanga (Sweden) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Sweden win a corner.
59' Ronald Koeman has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Guus Til (Netherlands) replacing Tijjani Reijnders.
59' Today's match ends for Frenkie de Jong who will be replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands).

59' 4 - 1 Goal! Alexander Isak puts Anthony Elanga (Sweden) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the left side of the goal. 4:1.
57' Wasted opportunity! Ryan Gravenberch (Netherlands) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
57' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Yasin Ayari (Sweden), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
56' Graham Potter prepares a substitution. Benjamin Nygren is replaced by Lucas Bergvall (Sweden).
56' It is time for a substitution. Besfort Zeneli (Sweden) is on for Jesper Karlstrom.
55' The referee signals a substitution. Anthony Elanga (Sweden) is brought on as a substitute for Alexander Bernhardsson.
54' 4 - 0 Goal! Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is teed up on the edge of the box by Crysencio Summerville, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 4:0.
53' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Sweden) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

50' A neat pass is well received by Cody Gakpo (Netherlands), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
47' 3 - 0 Goal! Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Denzel Dumfries. The score is 3:0.

46' Jesper Karlstrom (Sweden) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Oliver blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
46' Ronald Koeman has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) comes on the pitch for Donyell Malen.
46' The second half has just started.

45+5' Yasin Ayari (Sweden) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

45+5' Yasin Ayari (Sweden) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Bart Verbruggen was alert and the score remains the same. The referee signals a corner kick to Sweden.
45+4' A rebound bounces out to Benjamin Nygren (Sweden) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
45+3' Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is comfortably saved by Bart Verbruggen.
45+2' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Sweden earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

44' Ryan Gravenberch (Netherlands) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece.
41' That was close by Yasin Ayari (Sweden)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
40' Donyell Malen (Netherlands) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Brian Brobbey. The ball goes out of play and Sweden will have a goal kick.
38' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Kristoffer Nordfeldt is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
37' Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) drills a first-timer from the edge of the box that flew towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper stops the shot from going into his goal with a quick save.
35' Frenkie de Jong (Netherlands) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sweden.

33' This was a piece of cake for Bart Verbruggen. Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
31' Yasin Ayari (Sweden) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
30' Benjamin Nygren (Sweden) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
27' Jesper Karlstrom (Sweden) finds his way to a rebound inside the six-yard box thanks to his strength and unleashes a strike towards goal, but it ricochets away off one of his teammates.
26' The ball possession at the moment is 63:37.
23' The referee blows for a cooling break.
22' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' Gustaf Lagerbielke (Sweden) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Benjamin Nygren (Sweden) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
19' Benjamin Nygren (Sweden) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
17' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Denzel Dumfries feeds Brian Brobbey (Netherlands) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
15' Tijjani Reijnders (Netherlands) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the left post.
14' Flag up against Tijjani Reijnders (Netherlands). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
12' Tijjani Reijnders (Netherlands) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
12' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Netherlands will take a corner kick.

11' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Kristoffer Nordfeldt pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
9' Isak Hien (Sweden) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Alexander Isak (Sweden) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
8' Benjamin Nygren (Sweden) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

7' Great save! Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Bart Verbruggen. Sweden force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Cody Gakpo passes the ball to the feet of Brian Brobbey (Netherlands), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:0.

2' Jan Paul van Hecke (Netherlands) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
